copy_and_paste_description: These actions are unavailable via the menu. Please use:
repair_component_info: Repair invalid JSON, then click apply
repair_success: JSON is valid now and can be parsed.
wizard_description: (Only available for arrays, not for objects)
jsonquery_description: Enter a JSON Query function to filter, sort, or transform the data.You can use functions like get, filter,sort, pick, groupBy, uniq, etcetera. Example query: filter(.age >= 18)
jmespath_description: Enter a JMESPath query to filter, sort, or transform the JSON data. To learn JMESPath, go to the interactive tutorial.
jsonpath_description: Enter a JSONPath expression to filter, sort, or transform the data.
javascript_description: Enter a JavaScript function to filter, sort, or transform the data.
lodash_description: Enter a JavaScript function to filter, sort, or transform the data.You can use Lodashfunctions like _.map, _.filter,_.orderBy, _.sortBy, _.groupBy,_.pick, _.uniq, _.get, etcetera.
